resources.string: Installed does not mean Home takeover works. Test from another app with the remote.

Default HOME resolves to Tigris: %1$s
Guard service connected: %2$s
Secure settings permission: %3$s

These are configuration checks, not proof of Home takeover. Open another app and press the remote Home key. If stock Home returns, enable Home Guard below; it may require ADB authorization. Keep the stock launcher enabled.

Physical Home, standby/wake and reboot: not verified by this screen. Test each separately. USB installation alone does not grant system permissions.
